premises.text: Parents lack ready access to kids' critical medical info in emergencies and routine asks
premises.evidence_span: how many of you would know what's the last immunization your kid had if you were asked in the emergency room?

premises.text: A new law lets patients own medical records and require timely release after signed consent
premises.evidence_span: a law passed which says you now own your medical records. And once a proper release is signed, a doctor has to provide it to you in a timely fashion

premises.text: Parent-focused PHR surfaces immunizations, growth charts, and milestones—not generic adult labs
premises.evidence_span: what parents will be focused on are the immunizations, the growth charts, the last milestones, and it will not be your cholesterol levels

premises.text: Secure website plus mobile/iPhone app deliver the same records anytime, anywhere
premises.evidence_span: all this information available from a secure website and a mobile app

premises.text: Effortless intake: electronic release, fax from doctors, ingest system, and CS upload the data
premises.evidence_span: you have to sign an electronic release. We in turn take that release, send it to your doctor and your doctor will now use a new technology we like to call the fax

premises.text: Service is HIPAA compliant with extra security layers for cautious parents
premises.evidence_span: we are HIPAA compliant. And actually, we've added extra special layers of security

premises.text: Existing PHRs fail: self-entry burden, single-provider silos, and non-parent UI
premises.evidence_span: the existing players have three fatal flaws

premises.text: Target busy US moms via baby-site co-marketing; subscription ~cost of a latte/month
premises.evidence_span: 25 million moms living in the U.S. that spend $5-10 billion in the first year of a baby's life

value.text: Busy parents get kids' critical health info organized and available in their pocket anytime
value.evidence_span: access to all your kid's critical medical information available to you in your pocket, accessible anytime, from anywhere

starting with those who need it most, busy, caring moms
